description: This file defines a logging system with classes for managing log files, logging messages with severity levels, and flushing log data. It includes enum definitions, class declarations, and method signatures related to logging functionality.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: Singleton class managing log file operations such as writing, enabling/disabling, and resetting the log file.

classes.name: Flusher
classes.description: Helper class that buffers log messages and writes them with a specified severity and component name.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Main logging class that creates log entries associated with a specific component, providing an interface to log messages with severity levels.

methods.name: LogFile::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the LogFile class.

methods.name: LogFile::write
methods.description: Writes a line to the log file.

methods.name: LogFile::reset
methods.description: Resets or clears the log file.

methods.name: Flusher::operator<<
methods.description: Streams data into the log buffer.

methods.name: Logger::operator<<
methods.description: Creates a Flusher object to log messages with a specified severity.

methods.name: Logger::Logger
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger with a component name.
